name: De nuong
summary: Grilled mountain goat. DulichToday names dê nướng Ninh Bình at the end of its Tam Coc goat paragraph as the plate it says satisfies guests. The 20 October 2023 culture office also names dê nướng among Ninh Bình goat dishes, in the city or old-capital paragraph. Both stay.
origin: Restaurants at Tam Coc, and the city or old-capital paragraph on the culture office note.
howToEat: The herb list for thịt dê núi is the method named beside this plate. A separate grill method is Check on arrival.
where: Restaurants at Tam Coc, with no street named. A meal hour is Check on arrival.
